lines: No time, mama? You don't need an hour.
Wide fold. One minute, just breathe into it.
Straddle reach. One minute each side.
Side split fold. Easy does it, never force it.
caption:
No time? 10 minutes before the kids wake up is enough to move well. Save this for tomorrow morning and follow for part 2 🤍
